title: A $4,200 Diamond's Lab Twin Now Costs $380
hook: The same-looking diamond now costs a fraction of the natural one.
closing: When identical-looking stones diverge this much, buyers start questioning what rarity is worth.
question: Natural or lab-grown?

segments.say: A lab-grown diamond cost $1,400, then its price kept collapsing.
A lab-grown one-carat diamond now costs $380, making the same-looking stone dramatically cheaper.
Lab-grown centers reached 47 percent of US engagement rings, turning the alternative mainstream.
